program:
PARAMS = {
    "I":     (0.6e-6, 0.3e-6, 0.9e-6),
    "K":     (8.0, 4.0, 16.0),
    "gmidn": (20.0, 14.0, 24.0),
    "Ln":    (2.0, 1.0, 4.0),
    "gmidp": (12.0, 8.0, 15.0),
    "Lp":    (2.0, 1.0, 4.0),
    "Vptat": (0.21, 0.15, 0.26),
    "Mq":    (2, 1, 8),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    I = p["I"]; K = max(2, int(round(p["K"]))); Mq = max(1, int(round(p["Mq"])))
    Ln = p["Ln"]; Lp = p["Lp"]

    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], Ln, I, vds=0.5)
    W1 = m1.W; W2 = K * W1
    dV = 0.07
    for _ in range(4):
        lo, hi = 0.0, 1.2
        for _ in range(50):
            mid = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
            idm = lut.op("n", W2, Ln, mid, 0.4, vsb=dV)["Id"]
            if idm > I: hi = mid
            else: lo = mid
        vgs2 = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
        dV = max(0.02, m1.vgs - vgs2)
    R1 = dV / I
    R2 = p["Vptat"] / I

    mp = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], Lp, I, vds=0.6)

    n = Netlist("vdd vref vss")
    n.dev("M1", "n1", "n1", "vss", "vss", m1)
    n.M("M2", "pg", "n1", "s2", "vss", "nfet", W2, Ln)
    n.R("R1", "s2", "vss", R1)
    n.dev("M3", "pg", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.dev("M4", "n1", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.dev("M5", "vref", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.R("R2", "vref", "e3", R2)
    n.Q("Q3", "vss", "vss", "e3", m=Mq)
    n.C("CPG", "vdd", "pg", 1e-12)

    # Current-sensed start-up:
    # M6 copies core current into x; weak long nFET stack pulls x down.
    # Core off  -> x low  -> PMOS MS3 on  -> injects current into n1.
    # Core on   -> x ~ vdd -> MS3 off.
    n.dev("M6", "x", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    nodes = ["x", "k1", "k2", "k3", "k4", "k5", "vss"]
    for i in range(6):
        n.M("MSD%d" % i, nodes[i], "vdd", nodes[i + 1], "vss", "nfet", 0.42, 20.0)
    n.M("MS3", "n1", "x", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 0.42, 1.0)
    n.C("CS", "x", "vss", 50e-15)

    veb = 0.76 - UT * math.log(10e-6 / (I / Mq))
    vref = veb + p["Vptat"]
    slope = (veb - 1.2) / 300.0 + 3 * 0.0862e-3 + p["Vptat"] / 300.0
    tc = abs(slope) / vref * 1e6
    power = 1.98 * (4 * I * 398.0 / 300.0)
    rout = 1.0 / max(mp.gds, 1e-15)
    line_reg = (R2 + 1.0 / (Mq * 40 * I)) / rout + 0.02
    psrr = db(rout / (R2 + UT / I)) if rout > R2 else 6.0
    return n, {"vref": vref, "tc_ppm": tc, "power": power, "line_reg": line_reg,
               "psrr_1k": psrr, "startup_ok": 1}
